title: I want you/him/her/them to ... Tell him/her/them to ...
translation: 我要你/他/她/他们…… 告诉他/她/他们……
description: A picture lesson about the difference between 'I want you/him/her/them to...' and 'Tell him/her/them to...'. 16 pictures show people in various situations. The lesson covers positive and negative forms of 'want/tell + object + to + verb'.
answer_note: Textbook written exercises and practice A/B are open-ended (suggested answers). Grammar answers are from the grammar practice book key.

lesson.text: Lesson 106: I want you/him/her/them to ... Tell him/her/them to ...
lesson.translation: 第106课：我要你/他/她/他们…… 告诉他/她/他们……

lesson.text: Listen and answer the questions. Use 'I want you/him/her/them to...' or 'Tell him/her/them to...' to describe what the people in the pictures say and do.
lesson.translation: 听录音并回答问题。用'I want you/him/her/them to...'或'Tell him/her/them to...'描述图中人们说和做的事。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Look at the pictures and answer the questions using 'I want you/him/her/them to...' or 'Tell him/her/them to...'.
lesson.translation: 看图并回答问题，使用'I want you/him/her/them to...'或'Tell him/her/them to...'。
lesson.answer_note: Model answers based on the pictures.
lesson.context: Each picture shows a person in a specific situation. Use 'I want/tell + object + to + verb' to describe the situation.

questions.prompt: Picture K: A person carrying a box (carry it)
questions.answer: I want you to carry it.

questions.prompt: Picture L: A person correcting a mistake (correct it)
questions.answer: I want you to correct it.

questions.prompt: Picture M: People listening to music (listen to it)
questions.answer: I want you to listen to it.

questions.prompt: Picture N: A person describing a lost property (describe it)
questions.answer: I want you to describe it.

questions.prompt: Picture O: A person moving furniture (move it)
questions.answer: I want you to move it.

questions.prompt: Picture P: A person trying a cake (try it)
questions.answer: I want you to try it.

questions.prompt: Picture Q: A person finishing a job (finish it)
questions.answer: I want you to finish it.

questions.prompt: Picture R: A person keeping a photo (keep it)
questions.answer: I want you to keep it.

questions.prompt: Picture S: A person about to hurt yourself (hurt yourself)
questions.answer: I don't want you to hurt yourself.

questions.prompt: Picture T: A person slipping (slip)
questions.answer: I don't want you to slip.

questions.prompt: Picture U: A person falling (fall)
questions.answer: I don't want you to fall.

questions.prompt: Picture V: A person missing a bus (miss it)
questions.answer: I don't want you to miss it.

questions.prompt: Picture W: A person breaking a vase (break it)
questions.answer: I don't want you to break it.

questions.prompt: Picture X: A person driving a car (drive it)
questions.answer: I don't want you to drive it.

questions.prompt: Picture Y: A person losing a ten-pound note (lose it)
questions.answer: I don't want you to lose it.

questions.prompt: Picture Z: A person about to cut yourself (cut yourself)
questions.answer: I don't want you to cut yourself.

lesson.title: Written exercises A: Rewrite as statements with infinitives
lesson.instruction: Rewrite these sentences. Example: Please repair it. → I want you to repair it.
lesson.translation: 模仿例句将以下祈使句改写成带有动词不定式的陈述句。例句：请修理它。→ 我让你修理它。
lesson.answer_note: Model answers converting imperative sentences to statements with 'I want you to...'.
lesson.context: Convert each imperative sentence to a statement using 'I want you to + verb'.

questions.prompt: Please spell it.
questions.answer: I want you to spell it.

questions.prompt: Please telephone him.
questions.answer: I want you to telephone him.

questions.prompt: Please wear it.
questions.answer: I want you to wear it.

questions.prompt: Please ask her.
questions.answer: I want you to ask her.

questions.prompt: Please tell them.
questions.answer: I want you to tell them.

questions.prompt: Please help us.
questions.answer: I want you to help us.

lesson.title: Written exercises B: Write questions and answers
lesson.instruction: Write questions and answers. Example: Type it again! → What do you want me to do? I want you to type it again.
lesson.translation: 模仿例句改写以下句子。例句：重打一遍！→ 你要我做什么？我让你重打一遍。
lesson.answer_note: Model questions and answers using 'What do you want me to do? I want you to...'.
lesson.context: Write a question 'What do you want me to do?' and an answer 'I want you to...' for each imperative sentence.

questions.prompt: Carry it!
questions.answer: What do you want me to do? I want you to carry it.

questions.prompt: Correct it!
questions.answer: What do you want me to do? I want you to correct it.

questions.prompt: Listen to it!
questions.answer: What do you want me to do? I want you to listen to it.

questions.prompt: Describe it!
questions.answer: What do you want me to do? I want you to describe it.

questions.prompt: Move it!
questions.answer: What do you want me to do? I want you to move it.

questions.prompt: Try it!
questions.answer: What do you want me to do? I want you to try it.

questions.prompt: Finish it!
questions.answer: What do you want me to do? I want you to finish it.

questions.prompt: Keep it!
questions.answer: What do you want me to do? I want you to keep it.

lesson.title: Written exercises C: Rewrite with negative infinitives
lesson.instruction: Rewrite these sentences. Example: Don't type it again! (He/her) → He is telling her not to type it again. He doesn't want her to type it again.
lesson.translation: 模仿例句改写以下句子，注意不定式的否定形式。例句：不要重打！(他/她) → 他在告诉她不要重打。他不想让她重打。
lesson.answer_note: Model answers converting negative imperatives to statements with 'tell/want + object + not to + verb'.
lesson.context: Convert each negative imperative sentence to two statements using 'tell/want + object + not to + verb'.

questions.prompt: Don't hurt yourself! (She/him)
questions.answer: She is telling him not to hurt himself. She doesn't want him to hurt himself.

questions.prompt: Don't slip! (She/him)
questions.answer: She is telling him not to slip. She doesn't want him to slip.

questions.prompt: Don't fall! (She/him)
questions.answer: She is telling him not to fall. She doesn't want him to fall.

questions.prompt: Don't miss it! (She/them)
questions.answer: She is telling them not to miss it. She doesn't want them to miss it.

questions.prompt: Don't break it! (She/him)
questions.answer: She is telling him not to break it. She doesn't want him to break it.

questions.prompt: Don't drive it! (He/her)
questions.answer: He is telling her not to drive it. He doesn't want her to drive it.

lesson.title: Written exercises D: Answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions. Example: Why is he speaking to her? (type it again) → Because he doesn't want her to type it again.
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。例句：他为什么在跟她说话？(重打) → 因为他不想让她重打。
lesson.answer_note: Model answers using 'Because he/she doesn't want him/her/them to...'.
lesson.context: Answer each question using 'Because + subject + doesn't want + object + to + verb'.

questions.prompt: Why is she speaking to him? (hurt himself)
questions.answer: Because she doesn't want him to hurt himself.

questions.prompt: Why is she speaking to him? (slip)
questions.answer: Because she doesn't want him to slip.

questions.prompt: Why is she speaking to him? (fall)
questions.answer: Because she doesn't want him to fall.

questions.prompt: Why is she speaking to them? (miss it)
questions.answer: Because she doesn't want them to miss it.

questions.prompt: Why is she speaking to him? (break it)
questions.answer: Because she doesn't want him to break it.

questions.prompt: Why is he speaking to her? (lose it)
questions.answer: Because he doesn't want her to lose it.

practice.title: Practice A: What do you want me to do?
practice.instruction: Re-write the sentences like the example to use I want / I don't want ... to do in place of You / She / He / They must / mustn't ...
practice.translation: 模仿例句用 I want / I don't want ... to do 来改写以下句子。
practice.answer_note: Model answers converting 'must/mustn't' sentences to 'I want/I don't want...to' sentences.
practice.context: Convert each 'must/mustn't' sentence to an 'I want/I don't want...to' sentence. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: You must keep this photo. / You mustn't lose it.
questions.answer: I want you to keep this photo. / I don't want you to lose it.

questions.prompt: They must watch this film. / They mustn't miss it.
questions.answer: I want them to watch this film. / I don't want them to miss it.

questions.prompt: She must type this letter again. / She mustn't send it.
questions.answer: I want her to type this letter again. / I don't want her to send it.

questions.prompt: He must answer all the questions. / He mustn't forget any.
questions.answer: I want him to answer all the questions. / I don't want him to forget any.

practice.title: Practice B: Tell him to ... / Tell him not to ...
practice.instruction: Read what the boss thinks and write what he asks his assistant to tell other people.
practice.translation: 读出老板所想，写出老板让他的助手转告大家的事情。
practice.answer_note: Model answers converting 'must/mustn't' sentences to 'Tell him/her/them to/not to...' sentences.
practice.context: Convert each 'must/mustn't' sentence to a 'Tell him/her/them to/not to...' sentence. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: She must type that letter again. / She must not post it.
questions.answer: Tell her to type that letter again. / Tell her not to post it.

questions.prompt: He must drive carefully. / He must not drive fast.
questions.answer: Tell him to drive carefully. / Tell him not to drive fast.

questions.prompt: They must answer the questions. / They must not use a dictionary.
questions.answer: Tell them to answer the questions. / Tell them not to use a dictionary.

practice.title: Practice C: Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What do you say in each?
practice.translation: 读以下情境。在每种情况下你会说什么？
practice.answer_note: Open-ended situational exercises. Model answers provided.
practice.context: Complete each situation with an appropriate response using 'I want/I don't want...to' or 'Tell him/her/them to/not to...'.

questions.prompt: An English person tells you his/her name and you want to write it down. You can't spell it. How do you ask?
questions.answer: Could you spell it, please?

questions.prompt: Someone points out a mistake you have made in a job. How do you apologize?
questions.answer: I'm sorry about that. I'll correct it.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Rewrite with 'I want/I don't want + object + to + verb'
grammar.instruction: Rewrite the sentences, using the words given according to the example. Example: Shut the door, not the window. (you) → I want you to shut the door. I don't want you to shut the window.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词改写下列句子。例句：关上门，不要关上窗。（你）→ 我要你关上门。我不要你关上窗。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 106 I, PDF p.536-537)
grammar.context: Rewrite each imperative sentence using 'I want/I don't want + object + to + verb'. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: Shut the door, not the window. (you)
questions.answer: I want you to shut the door. I don't want you to shut the window.

questions.prompt: Walk on the pavement, not on the road. (them)
questions.answer: I want them to walk on the pavement. I don't want them to walk on the road.

questions.prompt: Write your answers on the answer sheet, not on the test paper. (you)
questions.answer: I want you to write your answers on the answer sheet. I don't want you to write your answers on the test paper.

questions.prompt: Do your homework at home, not at school. (him)
questions.answer: I want him to do his homework at home. I don't want him to do it at school.

questions.prompt: Paint it blue, not red. (him)
questions.answer: I want him to paint it blue. I don't want him to paint it red.

questions.prompt: Write your name at the top of the paper, not at the bottom. (her)
questions.answer: I want her to write her name at the top of the paper. I don't want her to write her name at the bottom of the paper.

questions.prompt: Speak English, not Chinese. (you)
questions.answer: I want you to speak English. I don't want you to speak Chinese.

questions.prompt: Drive slowly, not quickly. (him)
questions.answer: I want him to drive slowly. I don't want him to drive quickly.

questions.prompt: Use a pen, not a pencil. (her)
questions.answer: I want her to use a pen. I don't want her to use a pencil.

questions.prompt: Come home early, not late. (her)
questions.answer: I want her to come home early. I don't want her to come home late.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Rewrite with 'tell + object + to/not to + verb'
grammar.instruction: Rewrite the sentences, using the words given according to the example. Example: Be careful. Don't make any mistakes. (him) → Tell him to be careful. Tell him not to make any mistakes.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词改写下列句子。例句：小心。不要犯错误。（他）→ 叫他小心。叫他不要犯错误。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 106 II, PDF p.537)
grammar.context: Rewrite each pair of sentences using 'tell + object + to/not to + verb'. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: Be careful. Don't make any mistakes. (him)
questions.answer: Tell him to be careful. Tell him not to make any mistakes.

questions.prompt: Spell the words correctly. Don't spell them wrongly. (them)
questions.answer: Tell them to spell the words correctly. Tell them not to spell them wrongly.

questions.prompt: Be careful. Don't fall off the chair. (her)
questions.answer: Tell her to be careful. Tell her not to fall off the chair.

questions.prompt: Keep the book clean. Don't make it dirty. (him)
questions.answer: Tell him to keep the book clean. Tell him not to make it dirty.

questions.prompt: Use a black pen. Don't use a blue pen. (them)
questions.answer: Tell them to use a black pen. Tell them not to use a blue pen.

questions.prompt: Put the vase on the table. Don't put it on the floor. (her)
questions.answer: Tell her to put the vase on the table. Tell her not to put it on the floor.

questions.prompt: Stay in the room. Don't leave the room. (her)
questions.answer: Tell her to stay in the room. Tell her not to leave the room.

questions.prompt: Remember your umbrella. Don't leave it in the restaurant. (him)
questions.answer: Tell him to remember his umbrella. Tell him not to leave it in the restaurant.

questions.prompt: Walk slowly. Don't fall down. (him)
questions.answer: Tell him to walk slowly. Tell him not to fall down.

questions.prompt: Come to school early. Don't be late. (them)
questions.answer: Tell them to come to school early. Tell them not to be late.

items-grid.description: 16 pictures showing people in various situations (carrying, correcting, listening to, describing, moving, trying, finishing, keeping, hurting yourself, slipping, falling, missing, breaking, driving, losing, cutting yourself) with instructions for positive and negative forms
